descriptions.w3d_d28b_aim_track_80098388: Aim tracking: in mode 2 (+116) with a valid value (+152), sweeps from the eye point (member 0x8003e304 plus 8) to the target worm +136 unless gone or the own worm, then to the worm named by +152; when blocked sets +140 and derives head +148 and yaw +144, each wrapped, scaled by pi/2 and clamped to -1..1, using the yaw +124 through a built matrix (0x801f7538); otherwise clears +140.
